title: Find the Pivot Integer
description:
You are given a positive integer n.

Find an integer x (where 1 ≤ x ≤ n) such that:

The sum of all integers from 1 to x (inclusive) is equal to
The sum of all integers from x to n (inclusive)
Task

Return the pivot integer x.

If no such integer exists, return -1.
It is guaranteed that at most one such integer exists.
input_format: The input contains a single integer.
